INTRODUCTIONM
You will practice troubleshooting a Schmitt trigger for many typical faults that commonly occur.
Measuring and comparing the input to the output quickly determines if the circuit is operating correctly.
Measuring Vcc, checking transistors, and measuring circuit resistances usually identifies the fault.
